# TSBS DevOps — Memory by Host - 1 Hour

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Memory statistics per host

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    hostname,
    AVG(used_percent) as avg_used_pct,
    MAX(used_percent) as max_used_pct,
    MIN(available) as min_available
FROM mem
WHERE time >= '2024-01-02 00:00:00'
  AND time < '2024-01-02 01:00:00'
GROUP BY hostname
ORDER BY avg_used_pct DESC
```
